text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Red Desire, we decided to keep running
in domestic races while keeping a watchful eye against
a relapse of the "Crimson Wedge."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Our next race is the Sapporo Kinen, right in the middle of summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"In order to suppress the 'Crimson Wedge'...
I ask of you to fine-tune this body to absolute perfection during our summer training camp!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the summer training camp began—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah――!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer. Next up is...
choice_data_list: No, let's call it a day.
No, let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No way... Didn't training
literally just start...?
choice_data_list: Desire, can we talk for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What might this discussion be about...?
...I presume it is mostly regarding this body of mine, but...
choice_data_list: I think we should make 'recuperation' the main focus of this training camp.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "‘Recuperation’... Indeed, that is important as well."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However... at this summer training camp,
it's inevitable that everyone will push themselves and sharpen their skills.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If so, my Sapporo Kinen would...—
...No. Winning any other race
would become exceedingly difficult as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please tell me.
Tell me your thoughts. Tell me the path we should take.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she was to prevent a recurrence of the 'Crimson Wedge' while continuing
to run in races just as before, meticulous control over her training was essential."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, what Red Desire needs right now
isn't pushing past her physical limits, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Take your time to recuperate and get your mind and body back in shape.
choice_data_list: You gotta tame the "Crimson Wedge" with that body of yours.
You have to tame the "Crimson Wedge" with that body of yours.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: With this body, against the 'Crimson Wedge'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Crimson Wedge' forces a cruel fate upon us.
Overcoming it is the ultimate trial."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet as long as we're together, we can surely overcome it.
And... we will undoubtedly forge a path forward.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That's right...
Just now, I was driven by impatience...
I wasn't calm at all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Suppress this overflowing thirst, immerse myself in the silence... and calm my soul.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "So that is... the sacred ritual meant to tame the 'Crimson Wedge'...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Without suppressing the 'Crimson Wedge',
reaching that other world will remain an impossible dream."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I, Red Desire, swear that with this very body,
I shall tame the 'Crimson Wedge'!"
